items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: i had an old boy we used to call iron foot alonzo crumby i heard him on the record on your right he played drums

ctx.x: about a year ago and his big brother bud passed on oh yeah well now i see bud played bass too yeah
